chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى ٱبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ فُضَيْلِ بْنِ يَسَارٍ قَالَ:

translations.en: Ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, from Fudayl ibn Yasar, who said:

chunks.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ عَنِ ٱلذِّرَاعِ إِذَا ضُرِبَ فَٱنْكَسَرَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّنْدُ

translations.en: I asked Aba Abdillah عليه السلام about the forearm, when it is struck and the wrist-bone is fractured from it.

chunks.arabic_text: فَقَالَ «إِذَا يَبِسَتْ مِنْهُ ٱلْكَفُّ أَوْ شُلَّتْ أَصَابِعُ ٱلْكَفِّ كُلُّهَا فَإِنَّ فِيهَا ثُلُثَيْ دِيَةِ ٱلْيَدِ»

translations.en: He said: “If the hand withers from it, or all the fingers of the hand become paralyzed, then in it is two-thirds of the diyyah of the hand.”

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «وَ إِنْ شُلَّتْ بَعْضُ ٱلْأَصَابِعِ وَ بَقِيَ بَعْضٌ فَإِنَّ فِي كُلِّ إِصْبَعٍ شُلَّتْ ثُلُثَيْ دِيَتِهَا»

translations.en: He said: “And if some of the fingers are paralyzed while some remain, then for every finger that is paralyzed there is two-thirds of its diyyah.”

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «وَ كَذَلِكَ ٱلْحُكْمُ فِي ٱلسَّاقِ وَ ٱلْقَدَمِ إِذَا شُلَّتْ أَصَابِعُ ٱلْقَدَمِ».

translations.en: He said: “And likewise is the ruling regarding the ساق and the foot when the toes of the foot become paralyzed.”
translations.ur: انہوں نے فرمایا: "اور اسی طرح ساق اور پاؤں کے بارے میں حکم ہے جب پاؤں کی انگلیاں مفلوج ہو جائیں۔"
translations.tr: Şöyle dedi: “Ve ayak parmakları felç olduğunda, bacak ve ayak hakkında hüküm de aynıdır.”
translations.fa: فرمود: «و حکم ساق و پا نیز چنین است هنگامی که انگشتان پا فلج شوند.»
translations.id: Dia berkata: “Demikian pula hukum mengenai ساق dan kaki ketika jari-jari kaki menjadi lumpuh.”
translations.bn: তিনি বললেন: “এবং পায়ের আঙুলগুলো পঙ্গু হলে পা এবং পায়ের সম্পর্কে বিধানও একই রকম।”
translations.es: Él dijo: “Y de igual manera es el fallo respecto a la ساق y el pie cuando los dedos del pie se paralizan.”
translations.fr: Il a dit : « Et de même est le jugement concernant la jambe et le pied lorsque les orteils sont paralysés. »
translations.de: Er sagte: „Und ebenso ist das Urteil bezüglich des Unterschenkels und des Fußes, wenn die Zehen gelähmt sind.“
translations.ru: Он сказал: «И таково же постановление относительно голени и стопы, когда пальцы на ноге парализованы.»
translations.zh: 他说：“当脚趾麻痹时，关于小腿和脚的判决也是如此。”

en.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling concerning diyyah for injuries that cause paralysis in the hand or fingers after a fracture to the forearm and wrist area. It specifies that total paralysis of the hand or all its fingers entails two-thirds of the hand’s diyyah, and partial paralysis is assessed proportionally per finger, with the same rule applied to the leg and foot.
en.seo_question: What is the diyyah ruling if a hand or fingers become paralyzed after an arm injury?

key_terms.ٱلذِّرَاعِ: the forearm, the section of the arm below the elbow
key_terms.ٱلزَّنْدُ: the wrist-bone or wrist joint area
key_terms.شُلَّتْ: became paralyzed or lost normal movement
key_terms.ثُلُثَيْ دِيَةِ ٱلْيَدِ: two-thirds of the prescribed blood money for the hand
key_terms.ٱلسَّاقِ وَ ٱلْقَدَمِ: the leg and the foot, to which the same legal ruling applies
